cases.sentence: ___ был с Иосифом, и он преуспевал.
cases.translation: The Lord was with Joseph, and he prospered.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of был, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он преуспевал, живя в доме у своего египетского ___.
cases.translation: He prospered, living in the house of his Egyptian master.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Поэтому он доверил ___ все, что у него было.
cases.translation: So he entrusted Joseph with everything he had.
cases.explain: The verb доверить takes its indirect object (to whom) in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Она схватила его за ___ и сказала, «Ложись со мной».
cases.translation: She caught him by his garment and said, 'Lie with me.'
cases.explain: The construction хватать за + accusative (to grab by/at something) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иосиф нашел расположение в его глазах и стал его личным ___.
cases.translation: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his personal servant.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) takes its predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Он преуспевал, живя в ___ у своего египетского господина.
cases.translation: He prospered, living in the house of his Egyptian master.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Иосифа привели в Египет, и египтянин Патифар, сановник фараона и начальник его стражи, купил Иосифа у измаильтян, которые его туда привели.
reading.question: Who bought Joseph in Egypt?
options: Potiphar, an Egyptian officer of Pharaoh
reading.correct: Potiphar, an Egyptian officer of Pharaoh
reading.explain: The text says 'египтянин Патифар, сановник фараона... купил Иосифа' (the Egyptian Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, bought Joseph).

reading.ru: Патифар поставил его над своим домом и доверил ему все свои владения.
reading.question: What did Potiphar do after seeing the Lord's favor on Joseph?
options: He put Joseph in charge of his household and possessions
He sold Joseph to another master
He sent Joseph back to Canaan
reading.correct: He put Joseph in charge of his household and possessions
reading.explain: The text says Potiphar 'поставил его над своим домом и доверил ему все свои владения' (put him over his household and entrusted him with all his possessions).

reading.ru: Иосиф же был хорошо сложен и красив, и через некоторое время жена его господина стала заглядываться на него и сказала, «Ложись со мной».
reading.question: What did Potiphar's wife say to Joseph?
reading.explain: The text quotes her saying «Ложись со мной» ('Lie with me').

reading.ru: Как же я могу совершить такое великое зло и грех против Бога?»
reading.question: Why did Joseph refuse Potiphar's wife?
options: Because it would be a great wickedness and sin against God
Because he did not find her attractive
Because he feared only Potiphar's punishment
reading.correct: Because it would be a great wickedness and sin against God
reading.explain: Joseph asks how he 'могу совершить такое великое зло и грех против Бога' (could do such great wickedness and sin against God).

reading.ru: Она схватила его за одежду и сказала, «Ложись со мной», но он вырвался и убежал, оставив верхнюю одежду у нее в руках.
reading.question: What happened when Potiphar's wife grabbed Joseph?
options: He fled, leaving his garment in her hand
He gave in to her demand
He called for help from the servants
reading.correct: He fled, leaving his garment in her hand
reading.explain: The text says he 'вырвался и убежал, оставив верхнюю одежду у нее в руках' (tore free and fled, leaving his outer garment in her hands).

reading.ru: Он взял Иосифа и посадил его в темницу, где были заключены царские узники.
reading.question: What did Potiphar do to Joseph after hearing his wife's accusation?
options: He put him in the prison where the king's prisoners were kept
He sent him back to Canaan
He sold him to another Egyptian
reading.correct: He put him in the prison where the king's prisoners were kept
reading.explain: The text says he 'посадил его в темницу, где были заключены царские узники' (put him in the prison where the king's prisoners were kept).

reading.ru: Главный страж поставил Иосифа над всеми узниками, и он отвечал за все дела в темнице.
reading.question: What responsibility did the chief jailer give Joseph in prison?
options: Authority over all the prisoners and matters in the prison
Sole responsibility over the prison's money
reading.correct: Authority over all the prisoners and matters in the prison
reading.explain: The text says the chief jailer 'поставил Иосифа над всеми узниками, и он отвечал за все дела в темнице' (put Joseph over all the prisoners, and he was responsible for everything in the prison).
